subtype: Stage 1: A new claim on attention [Actor]
passage:
Daycare note, Tuesday pickup.
Chirag (5) was building with blocks when his mother, Lavanya, arrived carrying baby Lakshay with a shiny new rattle. Chirag ran to her, then saw the baby on her hip. He stopped. He grabbed the rattle and hit Lakshay's hand with it. Lakshay cried. Chirag's lip shook.
I knelt beside him. "You wanted Mumma's lap too." He nodded and pressed his face into my shoulder.
I suggested Lavanya give Chirag a hug first at pickup tomorrow. 🙂
— Charu Miss

qa.a: Lakshay was holding a shiny new rattle.

qa.q: What was Chirag feeling when he saw the baby on his mother's hip?
qa.a: He felt left out and hurt, even though he loves his mother and brother, and he could not say it in words.

qa.q: What small step did Charu Miss suggest?
qa.a: Charu Miss suggested Lavanya hug Chirag first at pickup, so he feels he still has his place.

qa.q: How might Lavanya feel seeing Chirag hit the baby?
qa.a: She may feel upset and confused, not realising at first that Chirag is feeling pushed aside.

grounding: It shows a five-year-old boy seeing his baby brother on his mother's lap with a shiny toy, feeling hurt and acting it out by grabbing and hitting.

subtype: Stage 1: A new claim on attention [Actor]
passage: In Navsari, the afternoon was hot and still. Zubin, five, came in from the lane and saw his baby brother Kaizad on Mamma's lap. Ritu Masi had brought Kaizad a shiny spinning top. Zubin stood by the door. Then he marched over, grabbed the top and pushed Kaizad's arm. Kaizad wailed. "Zubin!" Mamma said. Zubin threw the top on the floor and ran behind the cupboard. Ritu Masi found him there, hugging his knees. She sat down beside him and opened her arms.

qa.q: What did Ritu Masi bring for Kaizad?
qa.a: She brought him a shiny spinning top.

qa.q: Why did Zubin grab the top and push Kaizad?
qa.a: He felt hurt and left out seeing Kaizad on Mamma's lap with a new toy, and he did not have words for it.

qa.q: How could Mamma help Zubin at this stage?
qa.a: She could make room for Zubin on her lap too and say, "You wanted a turn with me," so he feels seen instead of only scolded.

qa.q: How does Ritu Masi see Zubin hiding behind the cupboard?
qa.a: She sees a sad little boy who needs comfort, so she sits beside him and opens her arms.

grounding: It illustrates a five-year-old boy who sees his baby brother getting a parent's lap and a shiny toy, and shows his hurt by grabbing and pushing.
